DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便の差出しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。封筒に私の旧住所が残っています。このまま使うと、返送先を間違えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒の旧差出住所と返送の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My old address remains on the envelope. If I use it like this, could the return address be mistaken?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the old sender address and ask about return delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い表記と新しい表記が同時に読めると、分かりにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If old and new details are readable together, it's confusing.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新住所はまだ書いていません。宛先は正しいので、差出人欄だけ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先正しく差出欄だけ修正したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't written the new one yet. The recipient address is correct; I only want to correct the sender field.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the destination is correct and only the sender field needs correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法を窓口担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can ask counter staff about correction methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。新住所を小さく付け足して、どちらが今の住所か曖昧にするのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新旧両方を曖昧に残すのを避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to avoid adding the new address in tiny writing and leaving it unclear which address is current.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid leaving old and new details ambiguously together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人欄を読みやすく書き直す方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to rewrite the sender field legibly.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、この紙に現住所を書き、旧欄を覆ってよいか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現住所の紙で旧欄を覆えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then may I write the current address on this paper and have you check whether it can cover the old field?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether paper with your current address may cover the old field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先や料金の表示は隠さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't cover the recipient or postage information.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。差出人欄だけ直し、投函する前に読みやすいか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の表示を隠さず投函前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll correct only the sender field and check legibility before posting.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep other labels visible and check before posting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 修正後に窓口へお持ちください。宛先と差出人を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring it to the counter after correction. We'll check recipient and sender separately.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 材料の準備はできていますか。

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱に札が二つ付いています。材質が違うので、どちらが今の材料か分かりません。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 材質が違う二枚の札を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two labels are attached to the box with different material types, so I don't know which describes the current material.
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report two labels showing different materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部品を取り出しましたか。

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。古い札を自分で外す前に、材料番号を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未取出しで材料番号確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I'd like to check the material number before removing an old label myself.
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say nothing is taken out and request material-number checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱番号と二枚の札を見せてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show me the box number and both labels.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱番号はこちらです。上の札は今日の日付ですが、日付が新しいだけで正しいとは判断していません。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱番号と日付だけでは判断しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the box number. The upper label has today's date, but I haven't judged it correct just because it's newer.
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the box number and explain you won't judge by date alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管担当へ箱の履歴を確認します。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the box history with storage staff.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。確認中の箱を、使用予定の材料と分けて置いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を確認待ちの場所へ分ける相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. May I put this box under checking separately from the materials planned for use?
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to separate the box into the awaiting-verification area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認待ちの場所へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, put it in the waiting-for-check area.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこへ移します。材質と番号が合ってから、どの札を残すかも指示をください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材質番号と札処理の指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move it there. After the material and number match, please also tell me which label to keep.
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for instructions on material/number matching and label handling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 履歴を照合してお伝えします。この箱の材料は、確認が終わるまで使わないでください。
DLG-SC-NGT-SANJO-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll compare the history and tell you. Don't use this box's material until checking is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 板を作業台へ運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please carry the boards to the workbench.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手前の板だけですか。奥にも同じ形の板がありますが、乾燥中の札が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乾燥札付きの板も移すのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only the front boards? There are identically shaped ones farther back, but they're labeled drying.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether boards marked drying should also move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乾燥中の板はまだ動かしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't move the drying boards yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。手前の札なしの板も、加工待ちのものか確認してから運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札なしの板も加工対象か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'd also like to check whether the unlabeled front boards are for processing before carrying them.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether unlabeled boards are also the processing target. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要なのは、注文番号二番の束です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need the bundle for order number two.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二番の札を見つけました。乾燥中の束と同じ棚なので、取り違えないよう一本ずつ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文番号を見て乾燥束との混同を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've found the number-two tag. It's on the same shelf as the drying bundle, so I'll check each board to avoid mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the order number and avoid confusing the drying bundle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運ぶ量は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know how many to carry?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初は五枚ですね。多く運ぶと作業台をふさぐので、残りは棚に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初に運ぶ五枚と台をふさがない理由を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Five first, right? Too many would block the bench, so I'll leave the rest on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the first five and the reason not to block the bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。重い板は二人で運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Two people should carry heavy boards.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五枚を同僚と運びます。乾燥中の束は残して、運んだ注文番号を作業台でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で対象だけ運び到着先でも番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll carry five with a coworker, leave the drying bundle, and check the delivered order number at the bench too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Carry only the target with two people and check its number at the destination too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。二番の五枚だけ、指定の台へ運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Take only five from number two to the designated bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この工具をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for this tool?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。箱の本体のみという表示は、電池が付いていない意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体のみ表示と電池の有無を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Does body only on the box mean there's no battery?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the body-only label and battery inclusion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品は本体だけです。対応する電池はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product is the body only. Do you have a compatible battery?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っていません。家に別メーカーの電池はありますが、合うとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対応電池を持たず他社品の互換を決めつけないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I have another maker's battery at home, but don't assume it fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you lack a matching battery and won't assume another brand is compatible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使うためには、対応電池と充電器を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to check a compatible battery and charger to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全部そろえた時の金額を教えてください。本体の安さだけで決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要品を含む合計額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tell me the cost with everything included. I don't want to decide just by a cheap tool-body price.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the total including required items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: セット商品もあります。使用目的をお聞きしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also have sets. May I ask your intended use?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の棚の組立です。仕事で毎日使う予定ではないので、必要な機能も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚組立という使用目的と頻度を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Assembling shelves at home. I won't use it daily at work, so I'd like advice about necessary functions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain home-shelf assembly and usage frequency. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この二つを比較できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では本体、電池、充電器の内容と合計額を比べて、持ち帰る商品を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: セット内容と合計額を比較して選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll compare body, battery and charger contents and total prices before deciding what to take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare set contents and total price to choose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが内容一覧です。箱に含まれる物を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the contents list. Let's check what's included in the box together.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 認証の操作についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。コードが届きません。端末には二つの番号がありますが、表示は前の番号です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二番号の旧送信先にコードが届かないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The code hasn't arrived. My device has two numbers, but the display shows the previous one.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a code not arriving at an old destination among two numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今も前の番号で受信できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you still receive on the previous number?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約は残っていますが、今日はその回線を使っていません。新しい番号だけを見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧回線契約ありだが新回線のみ見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract remains, but I'm not using that line today. I was checking only the new number.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the old line still has a contract but you only checked the new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録の送信先と受信する回線を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the registered destination and receiving line.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。何度も再送を押す前に、どちらへ送る操作なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再送前に送信回線を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Before pressing resend repeatedly, I want to know which line the operation sends to.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the sending line before resending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面の送信先の末尾を見せてください。コード自体は知らせないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the ending digits of the destination on screen. Don't disclose the code itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 末尾は前の番号と一致します。本人の操作で、その番号の受信を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 末尾一致を示しコードを開示せず受信確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The ending matches my previous number. I'll check reception on that number through my own operation.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show matching ending digits and check receipt without disclosing the code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録番号の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to change your registered number?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今後は新しい番号を使いたいです。今日は受信先を確認し、変更はそのサービスの本人手続きで進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日受信確認とサービス登録変更を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to use the new one going forward. Today I'll check the receiving destination; I'll change registration through that service's identity-verified procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate today's receipt check from changing the service registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの番号と送信先を確認できました。コードを他人へ渡さず、サービスの案内に沿って操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked the two numbers and destination. Don't give codes to others; follow the service instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日から搬入先が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The delivery destination changes from today.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 確認です。朝礼にまだ来ていない同僚がいます。変更は私から伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席同僚への変更連絡担当を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Let me check: a coworker hasn't reached morning assembly yet. Should I tell them about the change?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask who should notify the absent coworker of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡担当はこちらで決めます。その方は何時に来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll decide the contact responsibility here. When will they arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと十分ほどです。昨日の指示のまま、旧入口へ行くかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着予定と旧入口へ行く可能性を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: In about ten minutes. They may go to the old entrance following yesterday's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report arrival estimate and the possibility of using the old entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着時に責任者へ寄るよう連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell them to see the supervisor upon arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。新入口へ直接行かせるのではなく、先に責任者の説明を受けるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接作業へ向かわせず責任者へ案内すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll tell them to hear the supervisor's explanation first, rather than send them directly to the new entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat referring them to the supervisor rather than directly to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更図はどこにあるか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know where the changed-layout diagram is?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝礼の掲示板ですね。私の手書き図だけを正式な変更図として渡さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式な掲示図と手書き図を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the morning-assembly noticeboard. I won't give them only my hand sketch as if it's the official change diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the official posted diagram from a hand sketch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。到着の連絡もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Please report their arrival too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同僚へ先に連絡し、来たら責任者へつなぎます。説明を聞いたかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着後に責任者へつなぎ説明受領を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact them first, connect them to the supervisor when they arrive, and check that they've heard the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Refer them to the supervisor after arrival and verify receipt of the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。作業の指示は責任者が本人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. The supervisor will give them work instructions personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車が長く止まっています。乗り換えないと目的地へ行けませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い停車が乗換えを意味するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This train has been stopped a long time. Do I have to change trains to reach my destination?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a long stop means a transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 速い列車を先に通すために待っています。どこまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're waiting to let a faster train pass. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三つ先の駅です。降りて別の列車を探す必要があるのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的駅と降車要否の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three stations ahead. I don't know whether I need to get off and find another train.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the destination and uncertainty about getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列車はその駅へ行きます。次に通る列車が止まるかは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This train goes there. Whether the next passing train stops there needs separate checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この列車に残ります。速い列車なら必ず早く着くと思って降りるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当列車に残り速い列車の停車を推測しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll stay on this train. I won't get off assuming a faster train must get me there sooner.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stay on this train without guessing the fast train's stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お急ぎの約束はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have an urgent appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありますが、残り時間を相手へ伝えます。乗換えを繰り返すより、今の到着案内を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 約束相手へ時間を連絡し到着案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, but I'll tell the other person the remaining time. Rather than change repeatedly, I'd like to check the current arrival information.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact your appointment about timing and check arrival information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for the departure announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。車内の表示も見て、予定変更は相手へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車内表示と発車案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll also check the onboard display and tell them about changed plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Watch onboard displays and wait for departure guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。発車時に案内します。行き先はこの列車で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Wait here as you are; we'll announce departure. This train is right for your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この棚をご検討ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you considering this shelving unit?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。部屋の壁には置けますが、玄関を通して運べるか測っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 設置場所はあるが玄関搬入が未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There's wall space in my room, but I haven't measured whether it can be carried through the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the installation space exists but entrance access is unchecked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 組立後の状態でのお届けか、部材でのお届けかも関係します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether it's delivered assembled or as parts matters too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この商品はどちらですか。完成品の幅だけ見て決めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完成品か部材配送かを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Which is this one? I want to avoid deciding from finished width alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether delivery is assembled or in parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この棚は組み立てた完成品でお届けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We deliver this shelving fully assembled.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では玄関と廊下の曲がり角も測ります。部屋に空きがあるだけでは搬入できるとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 玄関と曲がり角も測ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll measure the entrance and corridor corner too. Empty space in the room alone doesn't mean it can get in.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll measure the entrance and corner too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: エレベーターのある建物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does your building have an elevator?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。扉と内部の大きさも確認します。階段で運ぶ前提に勝手に変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: エレベーター寸法と階段利用の未承諾を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll check its doorway and interior dimensions. Please don't switch to stair delivery without my agreement.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain elevator measurements and lack of agreement to stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 搬入条件を確認してから、配送相談へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll discuss delivery after checking access conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は寸法一覧をもらい、家で経路を測ります。確認前の配送予約はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法一覧を受け取り予約前に経路を測る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take a dimension list and measure the route at home. I won't book delivery before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take dimensions and measure the route before booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが寸法一覧です。測った経路と建物条件をお持ちいただければ、配送担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the dimension list. Bring route measurements and building conditions to consult delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加のお料理をお持ちしました。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。私たちはまだ追加を頼んでいません。隣の席の注文ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未注文の料理で卓違いの可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me, we haven't ordered anything extra yet. Could that be the next table's order?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the dish is unordered and possibly for another table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文票を確認します。最初のご注文は何でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the order slip. What did you order originally?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼き魚と枝豆です。この揚げ物は頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の注文と届いた別料理を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Grilled fish and edamame. We didn't order this fried dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your order and the different dish delivered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卓番号を取り違えたようです。まだ箸は付けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It seems I mixed up table numbers. Have you eaten any yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、食べていません。手を付けず、こちらの端に置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未喫食と置いた場所を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, we haven't eaten it. It's untouched at this edge of the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report no eating and where it's placed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 失礼しました。こちらで下げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'm sorry. I'll take it away.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。注文履歴と会計にも、この揚げ物が入っていないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理撤去と注文履歴会計確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Also check that the fried dish isn't in our order history or bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request dish removal and checking order history and billing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この卓の注文には入っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It wasn't in this table's order.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認ありがとうございます。追加は必要になったら改めて頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加注文は別に行うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for checking. If we need anything extra, we'll order it separately later.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm additions will be ordered separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 揚げ物は下げました。ご注文は焼き魚と枝豆のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-SANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've cleared the fried dish. Your order remains grilled fish and edamame.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水の様子はどうですか。

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一か所だけ水が少なく見えます。ただ、田んぼの名前をまだ覚えていません。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水の異常と田名を知らないことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only one field seems low on water. But I haven't learned the field names yet.
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report unusual water levels and not knowing the field name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 位置を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you point it out on a map?

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯の地図に印を付けます。道路から二枚目で、赤い作業小屋の向かいです。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図と道路小屋の目印で地点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll mark my phone map. It's the second field from the road, opposite the red work hut.
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show location with map, road and hut landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水の調整はもう行いましたか。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you adjusted the water already?

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。別の田の入口を開けると困るので、触らず報告しています。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未操作で誤った田の調整を避けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Opening another field's inlet would cause trouble, so I've reported without touching it.
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no operation was done to avoid adjusting the wrong field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 印と写真を送ってください。こちらで地点を確認します。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Send the mark and photographs; we'll confirm the location.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全体が分かる写真と、水が少ない部分の写真を分けて送ります。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体と異常部の写真を分けて送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send separate photos showing the whole field and the low-water area.
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Send overall and abnormal-area photos separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できるまで、その場所で待てますか。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you wait there until we confirm?

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、安全な通路で待ちます。田んぼへ入って調整するのは、地点と指示を確認してからにします。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な通路で地点確認と指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, on a safe path. I'll only enter and adjust after verifying the location and instructions.
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait on a safe path for location checks and instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真を確認します。まず地点を照合し、必要な作業はそのあと指示します。
DLG-SC-NIG-JOETSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the photos. First we'll match the location, then instruct any necessary work.
